text:
Delhi to Mumbai Expressway: promised by 2024, still being built in 2026.
929 of 1,445 km was operational as of March 2026 (about 64%); ₹77,558 crore of the ₹96,547 crore sanctioned was spent by Dec 2025.
Delhi to Vadodara missed its June 2026 target; the last packages near Maharashtra are now due March 2028.
For anyone evaluating property marketed as "near the expressway": check which stretch is actually open.
Source: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways reply in Rajya Sabha (Mar 2026), via Business Today (5 Nov 2026). Educational content, not advice.
